reviews.t: ... these nails over them so it fit a little better on my hands but like the other reviews said ...
reviews.x: I got these for my catwoman costume and I was wearing gloves with these nails over them so it fit a little better on my hands but like the other reviews said the sizes are weird, they fit on my thumb and pinky alright just the three in the middle were pretty big.

reviews.t: Quality commensurate with price, but beware sizes
reviews.x: The sizes on these are strange. People's fingers vary a lot in size, obviously, and this is a set without any specific sizing information, so I didn't expect them to necessarily fit all my fingers correctly. But the way they didn't fit was surprising. The largest two barely fit on my thumb--if I push it down enough not to fall off, it cuts off my circulation. The smallest two fit on my pinky well, maybe a little small. The others, which you'd expect to be between those sizes...well, they are bet

reviews.t: They are huge! But fixable with some clear caulk!
reviews.x: The holes that your fingers go in are huge! I do have slim fingers but I laughed when I saw how big they were. I put clear silicone caulk on the insides and made them fit. They were a hit with the cosplay I used them with

reviews.t: sturdy metal and the gems are decent for the price
reviews.x: Claws themselves are very cute, sturdy metal and the gems are decent for the price. Would have put a 5 star for the material. Stars are because of size. The sizes are horrible, only the small size fits my pinky finger. the thumb sizes fit odd, too small but as if they would slip off since the sit so low on my thumb. the other six fingers (pointer, middle, ring) don't fit what so ever, way too big. My hands are on the smaller to regular female size but I didn't expect for these sizes to be so big

reviews.t: 100% made my Catwoman cosplay
reviews.x: These rings are metal so they feel very well-made. I bought the black and silver rings for my Catwoman cosplay and got more compliments on them than anything else. Everyone absolutely loved them. They were a bit big because they were one-size, but with my gloves and some small adjustments I made by re-sizing them with foam makeup pads hotglued inside they now fit perfectly and don't fall off. My ring finger is a size 6 and I would estimate that the medium rings are around an 8 although the pinki

reviews.t: Works, but doesn't fit all 5 fingers
reviews.x: These do what I wanted them to do, and ultimately I'm ordering another set, but the reason I'm doing that is...the sizes are INSANE.  They range from "large" to "tiny" and the tiny ones are PAINFUL.  They're really rigid metal (which is good, because that means they're durable), but they don't fit like they do in the picture.  I have US average woman's sized hands, and couldn't get my thumb in one and couldn't get my pinky in another, but the ones for my other fingers were too la

reviews.t: They are heavy so dont seam like they will break or bend easy
reviews.x: Sizes were way too small for my fingers. I will have to gift to friends with small hands. They are heavy so dont seam like they will break or bend easy. Wish i could have them adjusted for my big hands

reviews.t: One Star
reviews.x: Terrible material, questionable quality.

reviews.t: While it looks like the product that is displayed
reviews.x: While it looks like the product that is displayed, I had to cut the metal rings and expand them with tools in order to get them onto a 'moderate' male hand. While I could have kept them as is, they were creating pinching. They are great; and if your fine with modifying them to get them to fit well; it is a great item! One issue was the thumb that kept falling off; but with the purpose I had in mind with them, I managed to get them to stay and complete the costume I was making.

reviews.t: Not accurate sizes.
reviews.x: I'm not sure where the seller got their measurements, because my fingers supposedly match their measurements and these were huge! I had to add so much hot glue inside them to get them to fit and I still spent the day worried they would fall off. They look cool, but they do not fit.

reviews.t: I super glued them back on but it made the crystals ...
reviews.x: The fake little crystals came off on the pinky claw. I super glued them back on but it made the crystals look cloudy. Also, all of the crystals weren't there to glue back on so it has a hole.

reviews.t: Nice quality, decently sharp and an ok fit
reviews.x: Cute, decent fit. Obviously they're not going to fit perfectly for anyone as the size is as is, you'd need custom sizing for that. Nice quality, decently sharp and an ok fit.

reviews.t: Size Matters
reviews.x: These were really nice and pretty however I could not wear them from Halloween because the only person that could wear them as my husband's giant hands wish they had smaller

reviews.t: A very fun accessory for an imaginative kid
reviews.x: A very fun accessory for an imaginative kid.  They look amazing and stay on the fingers very well.  Careful or you'll poke your eye out! lol

reviews.t: Super talons!
reviews.x: You can't get a much better to give as a fun, goofy gift.  They are pretty strong, the jems stay-put.  We had fun with these.

reviews.t: itch
reviews.x: sizing you have to make adjustments because they are all the same, but the quality is excellent.

reviews.t: Loved them. Hard to stay
reviews.x: Variety but not enough variety. Used as cat woman. Loved them. Hard to stay on

reviews.t: Puurrfect!!
reviews.x: These were purrfect for my Catwoman Cosplay, I  glued them to my gloves

reviews.t: Great Idea, but It Could Be Better
reviews.x: I wanted something extra to go with my catwoman costume, and found these which I thought would be the perfect accessory. While it still is a great product when considering the idea, do realize that there are only 10 pieces, meaning that if some don't fit so well and tries to fall off, you're left to find a way to keep it on. For those curious, I am attempting to use hot glue on the inside of the ban of the ones I want to secure a little better. This product could have been better if you could ad

reviews.t: Super Cool
reviews.x: I am making a costume for a gaming convention, and this will save me roughly $30. I won't have to do my nails at a salon. I wish the individual packages had been labelled, but that is first thing I did. I checked for size, as they are not adjustable, and they fit fairly well. My ring fingers are smaller, so they have to be higher on the finger. I am hoping, if I am careful, I will not lose any. They will do the trick for dragon claws, for the dragonborn idea I am creating.

reviews.t: Pleasantly Surprised! Two clawed thumbs up.
reviews.x: These are great for me, I have small but chubby hands and these fit perfectly. My mom has slender fingers and they were a little big for her. The most shocking thing about these is the quality. These are almost heavy, all the rhinestones were in place, and each once was individually wrapped.

reviews.t: Looks great and good quality
reviews.x: Looks great and good quality, but were all big. I am plus size with fingers to match and even my fingers were sliding out of these all day. A few of my friends with daintier hands tried them on as well, but the rings slid down to the base of their fingers like normal rings.

reviews.t: Queen of the Night
reviews.x: Statement Made!!! These were the perfect touch to my outfit. I was Queen of the Ball. Easy to take off, the only thing is they can leave a green ring on your fingers after prolonged wear. So beware.Other than that everyone loves taking pictures and trying them on.

reviews.t: Sad
reviews.x: If your hands run on the larger side these would probably work. However if you have small hand they won't work. I only managed to get the pinkys and thumbs to fit, the other fingers went down to my first knuckle. The material looked very nice though

reviews.t: made for a very teeny fingers
reviews.x: Great product  I ordered a pair of black and I ordered a pair of gold the black fit perfectly and seem to be made for larger fingers for gold however seem to be made for a very teeny fingers I wish there was an option to get large medium or small

claims.text: Many reviewers report the sizing is inconsistent or strange, with rings that are too large or too small for their fingers.
Several reviewers say the metal is sturdy, durable, and well-made for the price.
Some reviewers had to modify the rings (with caulk, glue, or tools) to make them fit.
Reviewers describe the claws as cute and a hit for cosplay or as a fun gift.
A few reviewers mention quality issues like gems falling off or questionable material.
